cases.sentence: Электричка идёт от Серпа и Молота до ___.
cases.translation: The train goes from Serp i Molot to Karacharovo.
cases.explain: Предлог «до» always takes the genitive, so the neuter place-name Карачарово becomes Карачарова.

reading.question: What makes the chapter «Серп и Молот – Карачарово» famous?
options: It consists of a single short sentence
It is the longest chapter in the book
It is written entirely in verse
It describes the Kremlin at last
reading.correct: It consists of a single short sentence
reading.explain: After the author cut the profanity from the second edition, only the line «И немедленно выпил» remained — the whole chapter.
